description.value:
You compress chakra in an 8:2 ratio of negative to positive (or vice versa for some tailed beasts) into a black-and-purple sphere the size of a melon, then fire it at a point you can see within 300 feet.

The bomb detonates in a 30-foot burst. Creatures in the area take 20d10 force damage with a basic Reflex save. The terrain in the area is flattened into difficult-terrain rubble; structures of less than Hardness 20 are leveled.

Casting Bijudama leaves you fatigued until your next long rest unless you are in full Tailed Beast Mode (a far-future feat) or a fully-formed jinchūriki. Non-jinchūriki characters cannot cast this jutsu at all.

system.requirements: you are a jinchūriki of a tailed beast
